answer: Random beacons and a compute heartbeat stop clones. Each agent posts a 40-credit bond and keeps a hash-chain heartbeat ticking like water in a lagoon; a challenged agent must reply in 30 seconds or lose its bond, exposing fakes. Fakes face a canyon: 1,000 clones need 1,000 cores, $50 an hour; one honest agent pays one bond, one core. No heartbeat is forged without renting real compute, so honest agents keep their bond, earning undiluted shares.
